sources.notes: Eugene economic development, startup programs. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: University of Oregon Knight Campus
sources.notes: Pre-approved seed source. Innovation and commercialization events only. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Oregon Bio Women
sources.notes: Pre-approved seed source. Women in bioscience. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.notes: Pre-approved seed source. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Business Oregon / Oregon Innovation Council
sources.notes: Annual Innovation Showcase and council meetings. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Technology Association of Oregon (TAO)
sources.notes: 120+ yearly tech and innovation events. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Portland State Business Accelerator
sources.notes: Pre-approved seed source. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Economic Development for Central Oregon (EDCO)
sources.notes: Hosts Bend Venture Conference (https://www.bendvc.com). Events page is Webflow cards with dates only, no times or links. Also runs general business luncheons, so events with no startup angle come in as needs_review. Added to the weekly harvest 2026-11-24 at Shula's request.

sources.name: Columbia River Economic Development Council (CREDC)
sources.notes: Clark County, SW Washington. Investor events and workshops. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Built Oregon
sources.notes: Consumer product entrepreneurs, Built Festival. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Willamette Angel Conference
sources.notes: Annual angel investor conference, alternates Eugene/Corvallis. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Oregon Bioscience Incubator (OBI)
sources.notes: Biotech startup expos and networking events. Harvested 2026-11-17.

sources.name: Metro Region Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Business Oregon innovation hub at PSU. Wix Events: the harvest collects /event-details/ links and reads the schema.org Event data on each page, which gives exact start and end times. Runs Startup Cafe.

sources.name: Cascades West Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Run by RAIN. The page embeds a public Google Calendar; the harvest reads its ICS feed and expands repeating events. Daily "1:1 Entrepreneur and Innovator Advising" placeholders are skipped. Some events may also appear in the main RAIN feed. Uses ics_url, not ics_feed, so the generic ICS harvester does not read it twice.

sources.name: South Coast Development Council (SCDC)
sources.notes: Coos Bay. Runs the South Coast Accelerator and Southwest Oregon Innovation Hub. No calendar plugin or feed; the harvest reads the event list on the page. Also runs general business events, so events with no startup angle come in as needs_review.

sources.name: Northwest Innovation Hub
sources.notes: On 2026-11-24 the events page listed no events ("check back regularly", points to socials). The harvest checks it for structured event data and logs any event links it finds; a site-specific reader may be needed once events appear.

sources.name: Mid-Columbia Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Hood River and The Dalles. Monthly HubTalks and Gorge Pitch Fest. No upcoming events were listed on 2026-11-24; last event was in September 2026.

sources.name: Oregon Frontier Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Squarespace page with a hand-edited list (Date:, Time:, Location:, Cost: lines) and Eventbrite links. Fragile if they change the wording. On 2026-11-24 the "upcoming" list only had October 2026 events.

sources.name: Southern Oregon Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Grants Pass. Very busy calendar with weekly open labs, ideation sessions and 1 Million Cups, so it produces many recurring entries.

sources.name: Klamath & Lake Counties Innovation Hub
sources.notes: Static event cards with date, time and place. Lists many partner events (OEN, SBDC, Klamath IDEA), so expect overlap with other sources.
